mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (as of t-1mo) predicts positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns, as reduced discount rates enhance equity valuations and encourage risk allocation in financial markets.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS (as of t-1mo) is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index value above 275.0 (as of t-1mo) signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank hawkishness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns through reduced equity attractiveness.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL (as of t-1mo) exceeds 275.0, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and high retail sales (RSAFS > 620000.0) indicates robust consumer demand and tight labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns through elevated corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0 and RSAFS > 620000.0, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rise > 0.5% in 3 months), a rising INDPRO (above 100.0) indicates resilient industrial output that mitigates growth concerns, producing positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns despite policy normalization.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS has risen >0.5% in 3 months and INDPRO > 100.0, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE value above 5.0% (as of t-1mo) indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profitability, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE (as of t-1mo) exceeds 5.0, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) as of t-2mo predicts positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns, as robust manufacturing activity supports corporate earnings growth and economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO (as of t-2mo) is above 100.0, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A HOUST value above 1600.0 (thousands of units) as of t-2mo signals strong housing market activity that boosts consumer confidence and business investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST (as of t-2mo) exceeds 1600.0, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A lower level of total nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) as of t-1mo predicts negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns, as weak labor market conditions dampen consumer spending and corporate hiring momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS (as of t-1mo) is below 147000.0, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is less than 0.03.
